Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters necessary for principals of elementary schools, middle schools, high schools and other equivalent schools to select students with outstanding talents for early promotion or early graduation, or grant qualifications for early admission to schools of higher level, under Article 27 (1) of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act.
